# libebur128

Vendored upstream version: v1.2.6, https://github.com/jiixyj/libebur128

Unmodified files fetched from the v1.2.6 tag: ebur128/ebur128.c, ebur128/ebur128.h, COPYING and ebur128/queue/sys/queue.h.

The measurement library is MIT licensed; its bundled BSD queue header carries its own copyright and conditions. Both notices accompany the ZLPlay native binary. It is compiled into the executable, so users do not install a separate library or package manager.
